// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const SANDBOX_IMAGE_LIMITS: Readonly<{
    max_images: 4;
    max_bytes: number;
}>;

export declare const SANDBOX_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT: Readonly<Record<keyof typeof SANDBOX_INTEGRATION_OPERATIONS, Pick<SandboxOperationContract, 'kind' | 'input' | 'output' | 'effects'>>>;

export declare const SANDBOX_INTEGRATION_LIMITS: {
    readonly items: 200;
    readonly cursorLength: 16384;
    readonly configLength: 16384;
};

export declare const SANDBOX_INTEGRATION_OPERATIONS: {
    readonly health: "integration.health";
    readonly poll: "integration.poll";
    readonly account: "integration.account";
    readonly presentation: "integration.presentation";
};

export declare const SANDBOX_INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SLOT = "source";

export interface SandboxConnectionDescription {
    bound: boolean;
    display_name?: string;
    state?: 'connected' | 'reauth_required' | 'disconnected';
}

export interface SandboxConnectionRequest {
    url: string;
    record_key?: string;
    method?: 'GET' | 'HEAD' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE';
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    body?: string;
}

export interface SandboxConnectionResponse {
    status: number;
    headers: Record<string, string>;
    body: string;
    authenticated: boolean;
}

export interface SandboxEffects {
    storage?: Array<'read' | 'write'>;
    artifacts?: Array<'read' | 'write'>;
    capabilities?: string[];
    events?: string[];
    networkDomains?: string[];
    secretRefs?: string[];
    resources?: string[];
    projectDatabase?: Array<'read' | 'write'>;
    homeDatabase?: Array<'read' | 'write'>;
    projects?: Array<'exist'>;
    connections?: string[];
    materials?: Array<'read' | 'fetch' | 'fetch_local' | 'original'>;
    ownerFiles?: Array<'read' | 'write'>;
    model?: Array<'read' | 'invoke'>;
    modelSettings?: Array<'read' | 'save'>;
    imageGeneration?: Array<'read' | 'generate' | 'bind'>;
    background?: string[];
}

export type SandboxHostMessage = {
    type: 'call';
    id: string;
    operationId: string;
    input: SandboxJson;
} | {
    type: 'sdk-result';
    id: string;
    value: SandboxJson;
} | {
    type: 'sdk-error';
    id: string;
    code: string;
    message: string;
};

export interface SandboxIdentity {
    projectId: string | null;
    installationId: string;
    pluginId: string;
    namespace: 'preview' | 'installed';
}

export interface SandboxImageConnection {
    connection_id: string;
    display_name: string;
    state: string;
    target_origin?: string;
}

export interface SandboxImageRequest extends SandboxImageTarget {
    expected_revision: string;
    protocol: 'openai-images' | 'gemini';
    model: string;
    prompt: string;
    size?: string;
    aspect_ratio?: string;
}

export interface SandboxImageResult {
    images: Array<{
        base64: string;
        mime?: string;
    }>;
    revision: string;
}

export interface SandboxImageState {
    connection_id: string | null;
    available: boolean;
    has_key: boolean;
    revision: string;
    reason?: string;
}

export interface SandboxImageTarget {
    slot_id: string;
    base_url: string;
}

export type SandboxJson = null | boolean | number | string | SandboxJson[] | {
    [key: string]: SandboxJson;
};

export interface SandboxMaterialDocumentBatch {
    documents: Array<{
        name: string;
        format: 'markdown' | 'html' | 'text' | 'csv';
        content: string;
        coverage: {
            status: 'sufficient' | 'partial' | 'insufficient';
            issues: string[];
            truncated?: boolean;
        };
    }>;
    warnings: string[];
}

export interface SandboxMaterialExtraction {
    text: string;
    title?: string;
    extractor: string;
    pages: Array<{
        number: number;
        text: string;
        method: string;
        confidence: number | null;
        lines?: Array<{
            text: string;
            confidence: number | null;
        }>;
    }>;
    segments?: Array<{
        start_seconds: number;
        end_seconds: number;
        text: string;
    }>;
    frames?: Array<{
        seconds: number;
        text: string;
        confidence?: number | null;
    }>;
    duration_seconds?: number;
    coverage: {
        status: 'sufficient' | 'partial' | 'insufficient';
        truncated?: boolean;
        processed_pages: number;
        total_pages: number;
        issues: string[];
    };
}

export interface SandboxMaterialFile {
    file_name: string;
    data_base64: string;
}

export interface SandboxMaterialRequest {
    timeoutMs?: number;
    textFormat?: 'text' | 'markdown';
    pdfMode?: 'text' | 'ocr';
    ocrLanguages?: Array<'zh-Hans' | 'zh-Hant' | 'en-US'>;
}

export interface SandboxMaterialSourceContent {
    text: string;
    title?: string;
    source_url: string;
    provider: string;
    extractor: string;
    coverage: SandboxMaterialExtraction['coverage'];
    pages?: SandboxMaterialExtraction['pages'];
    segments?: SandboxMaterialExtraction['segments'];
    frames?: SandboxMaterialExtraction['frames'];
    model_required?: {
        approximate_bytes?: number;
        variant?: string;
    };
}

export type SandboxModelAvailability = {
    available: true;
    runtime_label?: string;
    vision?: boolean;
} | {
    available: false;
    code: string;
    reason: string;
    runtime_label?: string;
    vision?: boolean;
};

export interface SandboxModelChoice extends SandboxModelSelection {
    label: string;
    vision: boolean;
    reasoning_effort: boolean;
}

export interface SandboxModelRequest {
    prompt_id: string;
    data: string;
    system_id?: string;
    selection?: SandboxModelSelection;
    output?: 'text' | 'json';
    timeout_ms?: number;
    max_output_tokens?: number;
}

export interface SandboxModelResult {
    text: string;
    value?: SandboxJson;
    usage?: {
        input_tokens: number;
        output_tokens: number;
    };
}

export interface SandboxModelSelection {
    provider_id: string;
    model_id: string;
}

export interface SandboxModelSettingsView {
    configured: boolean;
    source: 'selection' | 'provider' | 'environment' | 'none';
    selection?: SandboxModelSelection;
    effective_selection?: SandboxModelSelection;
    providers: Array<{
        provider_id: string;
        name: string;
        enabled: boolean;
        has_credential: boolean;
        models: Array<{
            model_id: string;
            display_name: string;
            enabled: boolean;
        }>;
    }>;
}

export interface SandboxNetworkRequest {
    url: string;
    method?: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' | 'HEAD';
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    body?: string;
    secretRefs?: string[];
}

export interface SandboxNetworkResponse {
    status: number;
    headers: Record<string, string>;
    body: string;
}

export interface SandboxOperationContract {
    id: string;
    kind: 'query' | 'command';
    description?: string;
    input: SandboxSchema;
    output: SandboxSchema;
    errors: Array<{
        code: string;
        description: string;
    }>;
    effects: SandboxEffects;
    examples: SandboxOperationExample[];
}

export interface SandboxOperationExample {
    input: SandboxJson;
    output?: SandboxJson;
    outputIncludes?: SandboxJson;
    error?: string;
}

export type SandboxOperations = Record<string, (input: SandboxJson, sdk: SandboxSdk) => Promise<SandboxJson>>;

export interface SandboxOriginalPart {
    data_base64: string;
    byte_length: number;
    size: number;
    revision: string;
}

export type SandboxOwnerFileChange = {
    op: 'mkdir';
    path: string;
} | {
    op: 'write';
    path: string;
    data_base64: string;
    mode: 'create' | 'replace';
} | {
    op: 'replace_atomic';
    path: string;
    data_base64: string;
} | {
    op: 'copy';
    from: string;
    to: string;
} | {
    op: 'remove';
    path: string;
} | {
    op: 'set_access';
    path: string;
    access: 'readonly' | 'readwrite';
};

export interface SandboxOwnerFileContent {
    data_base64: string;
    byte_length: number;
}

export interface SandboxOwnerFileEntry {
    name: string;
    kind: 'file' | 'directory';
}

export type SandboxOwnerFileInfo = {
    kind: 'file';
    byte_length: number;
} | {
    kind: 'directory';
};

export interface SandboxPluginContract {
    version: 1;
    pluginId: string;
    revision: string;
    operations: SandboxOperationContract[];
    entities: Array<{
        id: string;
        schema: SandboxSchema;
        description?: string;
    }>;
    pages: Array<{
        id: string;
        title: string;
        regions: Array<{
            id: string;
            title: string;
            description?: string;
            operationIds: string[];
        }>;
    }>;
    acceptance: Array<{
        id: string;
        description: string;
        steps: Array<{
            description: string;
            operationId?: string;
            input?: SandboxJson;
            expected: string;
        }>;
    }>;
}

export interface SandboxSchema {
    type: 'null' | 'boolean' | 'number' | 'integer' | 'string' | 'array' | 'object';
    description?: string;
    enum?: SandboxJson[];
    const?: SandboxJson;
    properties?: Record<string, SandboxSchema>;
    required?: string[];
    additionalProperties?: false;
    items?: SandboxSchema;
    minItems?: number;
    maxItems?: number;
    minLength?: number;
    maxLength?: number;
    format?: 'date' | 'date-time' | 'uri';
    minimum?: number;
    maximum?: number;
}

export interface SandboxSdk {
    storage: {
        get(key: string): Promise<SandboxJson>;
        set(key: string, value: SandboxJson): Promise<void>;
        delete(key: string): Promise<void>;
        list(prefix?: string): Promise<Array<{
            key: string;
            value: SandboxJson;
        }>>;
    };
    artifacts: {
        get(reference: {
            artifact_id: string;
            version: number;
        }): Promise<SandboxJson>;
        put(value: SandboxJson): Promise<SandboxJson>;
    };
    capability: {
        call(id: string, input: SandboxJson): Promise<SandboxJson>;
    };
    events: {
        publish(id: string, payload: SandboxJson): Promise<void>;
    };
    network: {
        request(request: SandboxNetworkRequest): Promise<SandboxNetworkResponse>;
    };
    resource: {
        read(name: string): Promise<string>;
    };
    projectDatabase: {
        get(sql: string, parameters?: SandboxSqlValue[]): Promise<SandboxSqlRow | null>;
        all(sql: string, parameters?: SandboxSqlValue[]): Promise<SandboxSqlRow[]>;
        transaction(statements: SandboxSqlStatement[]): Promise<Array<{
            changes: number;
        }>>;
    };
    homeDatabase: {
        get(sql: string, parameters?: SandboxSqlValue[]): Promise<SandboxSqlRow | null>;
        all(sql: string, parameters?: SandboxSqlValue[]): Promise<SandboxSqlRow[]>;
        transaction(statements: SandboxSqlStatement[]): Promise<Array<{
            changes: number;
        }>>;
    };
    connections: {
        request(slot_id: string, request: SandboxConnectionRequest): Promise<SandboxConnectionResponse>;
        describe(slot_id: string, record_key?: string): Promise<SandboxConnectionDescription>;
        release(slot_id: string, record_key: string): Promise<void>;
    };
    materials: {
        imageTextAvailable(): Promise<boolean>;
        readDocuments(files: SandboxMaterialFile[], request?: Pick<SandboxMaterialRequest, 'timeoutMs'>): Promise<SandboxMaterialDocumentBatch>;
        extract(file: SandboxMaterialFile, request?: SandboxMaterialRequest): Promise<SandboxMaterialExtraction>;
        readSource(url: string): Promise<SandboxMaterialSourceContent>;
        readLocalPage(url: string): Promise<SandboxMaterialExtraction>;
        claimOriginal(record_key: string): Promise<void>;
        readOriginal(record_key: string, request?: {
            maxBytes?: number;
        }): Promise<{
            bytes: Uint8Array;
        }>;
        releaseOriginal(record_key: string): Promise<void>;
    };
    projects: {
        exist(ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, boolean>>>;
    };
    ownerFiles: {
        stat(path: string): Promise<SandboxOwnerFileInfo | null>;
        list(path: string): Promise<SandboxOwnerFileEntry[]>;
        read(path: string): Promise<SandboxOwnerFileContent | null>;
        write(changes: SandboxOwnerFileChange[]): Promise<void>;
    };
    model: {
        choices(): Promise<SandboxModelChoice[]>;
        availability(selection?: SandboxModelSelection): Promise<SandboxModelAvailability>;
        complete(request: SandboxModelRequest): Promise<SandboxModelResult>;
        settings: {
            read(): Promise<SandboxModelSettingsView>;
            save(selection: SandboxModelSelection): Promise<SandboxModelSettingsView>;
        };
    };
    imageGeneration: {
        connections(): Promise<SandboxImageConnection[]>;
        inspect(target: SandboxImageTarget): Promise<SandboxImageState>;
        bind(target: SandboxImageTarget, connection_id: string): Promise<void>;
        unbind(slot_id: string): Promise<void>;
        generate(request: SandboxImageRequest): Promise<SandboxImageResult>;
    };
    background: {
        start(operation: string, input: SandboxJson): Promise<string>;
        cancel(id: string): Promise<boolean>;
    };
    interaction: import('./plugin-interaction.js').PluginInteractionClient;
}

export type SandboxSdkMethod = 'storage.get' | 'storage.set' | 'storage.delete' | 'storage.list' | 'projects.exist' | 'artifacts.get' | 'artifacts.put' | 'capability.call' | 'events.publish' | 'network.request' | 'resource.read' | 'projectDatabase.get' | 'projectDatabase.all' | 'projectDatabase.transaction' | 'connections.request' | 'connections.describe' | 'connections.release' | 'homeDatabase.get' | 'homeDatabase.all' | 'homeDatabase.transaction' | 'materials.imageTextAvailable' | 'materials.readDocuments' | 'materials.extract' | 'materials.readSource' | 'materials.readLocalPage' | 'materials.claimOriginal' | 'materials.readOriginalRange' | 'materials.releaseOriginal' | 'ownerFiles.stat' | 'ownerFiles.list' | 'ownerFiles.read' | 'ownerFiles.write' | 'model.choices' | 'model.availability' | 'model.complete' | 'model.settings.read' | 'model.settings.save' | 'imageGeneration.connections' | 'imageGeneration.inspect' | 'imageGeneration.bind' | 'imageGeneration.unbind' | 'imageGeneration.generate' | 'background.start' | 'background.cancel' | 'interaction.questionHtml' | 'interaction.cardHtml' | 'interaction.nextStepsHtml';

export type SandboxSqlRow = {
    [column: string]: SandboxSqlValue;
};

export interface SandboxSqlStatement {
    sql: string;
    parameters?: SandboxSqlValue[];
}

export type SandboxSqlValue = null | number | string;

export type SandboxWorkerMessage = {
    type: 'ready';
    operations: string[];
} | {
    type: 'result';
    id: string;
    value: SandboxJson;
} | {
    type: 'error';
    id: string;
    code: string;
    message: string;
} | {
    type: 'sdk';
    id: string;
    callId: string;
    method: SandboxSdkMethod;
    args: SandboxJson[];
};
